items.raw_excerpt: Fórsa union members at Oberstown Children Detention Campus will take part in an eight-hour work stoppage later today.
items.summary_en: Workers from the Fórsa union at Oberstown Children Detention Campus will stop work for eight hours today. The stoppage is a dispute over working conditions at the youth detention facility.
items.summary_ko: 포르사 노조 소속 직원들이 오버스타운 아동 구금 시설에서 오늘 8시간 동안 작업을 중지합니다. 이번 중지는 청소년 구금 시설의 근로 조건을 둘러싼 분쟁에서 비롯됐습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Northern Marianas tennis player Carol Lee won the Warsaw T-Mobile Polish Open in Warsaw, Poland, on Saturday.
items.summary_en: Carol Lee, a tennis player from the Northern Mariana Islands, won the Warsaw T-Mobile Polish Open in Warsaw, Poland. It is her first WTA title. She won the final on Saturday.
items.summary_ko: 북마리아나 제도의 테니스 선수 캐럴 리가 폴란드 바르샤바에서 열린 바르샤바 T-모바일 폴란드 오픈에서 우승했다. 그녀에게는 생애 첫 WTA 타이틀이다. 리는 토요일에 열린 결승전에서 승리했다.
items.title_en: Northern Marianas' Carol Lee wins her first WTA title

items.summary_en: The first Epirote Musical Village will open at Ktismata in the Pogonio area. It is a small cultural project for music lovers in the mountains of Epirus. The village will host music events and workshops.
